name: REST endpoint returns 201 Created on valid site onboarding
title: SC-03-05-01 REST endpoint returns 201 Created on valid site onboarding
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

When sending POST request to /api/v1/saas/sites with valid payload
Then the HTTP status code is 201 Created
And response includes site_id, slug, admin_user_id, and temporary_password
